objects.description: During [3CX Supply Chain Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0057), [AppleJeus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1049) has gained access to the 3CX corporate environment through legitimate VPN credentials.(Citation: 3cx official statement 2023)
objects.description_fa: در طول [3CX Supply Chain Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0057)، [AppleJeus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1049) از طریق اعتبارنامه‌های قانونی VPN به محیط شرکتی 3CX دسترسی پیدا کرد.(Citation: 3cx official statement 2023)
